_convention: A rep counts when the person goes from the start position to depth and back to the start position. Partial reps cut off by the start or end of a clip don't count. Counted by eye from frame strips (3 to 6 frames a second), never from the model's output.

_heldOut: Clips marked heldOut were counted by hand and recorded here before being run through the engine, and the engine was not changed afterwards. All other clips were used while developing the engine.
